hero.subtext: I'm Nate Winter, a Milwaukee-based designer and art director focused on product-led brands. Most of what I make starts in 3D, where I control every angle, surface, and reflection and get shots a camera never could. From there I build out the motion, packaging, and brand around it, so the product stands out wherever it lands, on a shelf, a site, or a feed.

about.title: Strong creative direction, rendered honestly.
about.lead: I'm a Digital Media Artist based in Milwaukee, working across 3D product visualization, brand and packaging design, and motion graphics, where design and marketing meet. I make products look the way they deserve, in films, in stills, and on every shelf and feed that follows.
about.body1: I started in graphic design and went deep on 3D when I realized it was the fastest way to bring an art-directed world to life. That graphic-design foundation is still in everything I ship, and it's why the brand and packaging work feels at home next to the renders.
about.body2: Most engagements run 3–8 weeks, a hero film and a stills system, sometimes extending into pack design or a full brand refresh. I'm also open to single deliverables, day-rate creative direction, and ongoing retainers. Smaller briefs are welcome.

services.title: Product animation
services.desc: Hero films, launch loops, and short-form cutdowns, the headline service. Built on locked art direction so every shot stays of a piece.

services.title: Product stills
services.desc: 3D stills for PDPs, paid social, retail signage, and Amazon A+, drawn from the same visual system as the film, so the campaign reads as one thing.

services.title: Brand & packaging design
services.desc: Identity systems, pack design, and the typography and visual language that earn the shelf. Often paired with a stills library so the brand lands cohesive day one.

services.title: Creative direction & consulting
services.desc: By the day or week. Concept, art direction, design critique, or extra hands on someone else's brief. Lower commitment, same craft.

contact.title: Have a launch on the calendar? Let's talk.
contact.lead: I take a range of projects each quarter, from single deliverables and short engagements to multi-month campaigns and ongoing creative direction. Also open to full-time and contract roles with the right team. Share your scope, timeline, or opportunity. A short note is all I need to get started.
expect: I reply within two business days.
We hop on a 30-minute fit call.
You get a fixed-scope proposal within a week.
